entry: 2026-09-12 — Mock GitHub Testing Improvements — accs correction

verification.summary: Both previous mustFix items (zero-comments-at-startup check, per-issue comment-count check for non-first issues) are now implemented, and both shouldFix items (anonymous curl, per-issue 'been here' check) are also fixed.

shouldKnow.problem: This counts every Issue # line across the whole log so far, not just the first snapshot's block, so the later growth comparison (SECOND_SNAP_ISSUES > FIRST_SNAP_ISSUES) is a cumulative-lines signal rather than a clean 'latest snapshot has more unique issues' signal. Still monotonic and good enough to detect streaming, just worth knowing it's not as precise as it reads.

shouldKnow.quote: IF AT ANY POINT YOU NOTICE THAT AN ISSUES APPEARS TWICE, TERMINATE WITH AN ERROR!
shouldKnow.problem: accs.md's final 'check comments don't appear twice' line is implemented as a duplicate-Issue-#-per-snapshot check, matching this closing instruction's literal wording about issues repeating rather than a duplicate-comment-content check. Reasonable reading, just noting the interpretation choice.
